variant_note: 16GB default pin is catalog variant base. Its checkpoint is the distilled 10Eros bake (DEFAULT_ALL_IN_ONE_CKPT). A brief that says rainey1 stays on base even when it also says photoreal. Phase 0 ships no style LoRA and no face identity.
identity_policy: Steal craft, not identity. Do not ship Jason Rainey's face as a hero, character asset, or LoRA. Lock the brief's own character (Scott / Blaze / KK / operator plate).
negative: identity drift, face morph, twin faces, melted face, extra fingers, glow soup, rainbow noise, sparse melt, soft beauty filter, plastic skin, cartoon, anime, lowres, jpeg artifacts, watermark, subtitle, UI overlay, handheld phone selfie, empty flat lighting, toy MIDI vibe, stock b-roll look, random scene jump every frame, text burned in, logo burn

recipes.notes: Start 768x512 at 25 frames (8n+1). That pair is above the 25-frame ladder rung. OOM walks DOWNSCALE_LADDER; the next legal length after 25 is 33. Never queue length 8.

recipes.prompt_pattern: same locked character, 9:16 story frame composed for a center crop, craft owns the top third, emissive rim light, identity stable, no text overlay
recipes.delivery: 16:9 plate then ffmpeg center-crop to 9:16. Portrait 512x768 is not a legal start size: clamp_resolution caps height at 512 (balanced) or 384 (draft). Generate the DOWNSCALE_LADDER rung 640x384x17, then crop width to height*9/16 (216x384): ffmpeg -i plate.mp4 -vf crop=216:384 story.mp4
recipes.notes: Vertical latent is unsupported on this pin. Honor DOWNSCALE_LADDER (640, 384, 17) and crop.
